summary: The owner explicitly authorized this chat to take over game implementation on 17 October 2026 and install Qodo. Repair a JavaScript ES module landscape strategy game's professional presentation and usability against 30 approved mocks. Scope reviewed here: index stylesheet wiring, screen-presentation.js helpers, polish.css, main.js presentation and a focused test file. The repository already has extensive uncommitted work from earlier executors; do not attribute the entire diff to this turn.
decisions: Keep campaign rules, saved IDs, economics, legal navigation and existing assets intact; client presentation adapts to state.
Show discovered Adventure landmarks and a recognizable hometown, with legal route previews and explicit commits. Fog must not reveal undiscovered sites.
Use selectable owned formations and separate recruitment previews, stable IDs and core-checked recruitment preconditions.
Use three equipment sockets on each side and contextual inspect/compare/unequip rather than silently navigating every slot to Forge.
Render live wave/core/turn feedback. Defense opens using the existing paused state to allow deployment; no new combat economics.
Result presentation previews the pure core settlement command on a clone; confirmation commits the actual settlement once. Check this for RNG/state side effects or misleading rewards.
Do not claim complete visual acceptance, all natural journeys or art geometry repair from tests. No APK checkpoint build or provider calls in this pass so far.
